title: How to Edit the Footer
text:
## How to Edit the Footer
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000033058
The footer of every Brilliant Directories website is controlled through the Menu Manager. This article covers editing the footer content, links, and column layout.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180301735/original/S_GNVFIfYxXmvV3yoJNLZe_tuewu8Vgyyw.png?1781232660 | alt: ]
To edit the content in the footer or add additional links, follow the steps below.
1. Go to Toolbox >> Menu Manager and click Customize on the Footer Menu :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180301805/original/8jW58kYh2dK8XEUFOT7-hPYt4iR36CYAlg.png?1781232915 | alt: ]
2. Click the green button to collapse the menu items:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180301817/original/81G4reFcSM9hZtPwWSikrRo-5WjViVMIFw.png?1781232990 | alt: ]
3. Click, hold, and drag the bottom corner of the text box to make it larger, allowing the text to be edited more easily:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180301829/original/3XsVHWU9AmlE7-ishsbBgPARxICHta7SIQ.png?1781233041 | alt: ]
4. The links can be edited in the highlighted text area:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180301842/original/BNYekLP8RVaPFUqUSRQnR88UxxDwkEXosw.png?1781233103 | alt: ]
5. The order and position of the columns can be adjusted in the Outer <li> CSS Class field:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180301865/original/IQWLl0sQtjnYCjO5KxrkrUC8vzVXiv5tgw.png?1781233173 | alt: ]
Additional information: How to Edit the Options for Menu Links
6. Inside the Actions drop-down, menu items can be added, cloned, or deleted:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180301871/original/kyht29wRlW-CL6E0x-6JFYwjCxkeCJ3k5A.png?1781233235 | alt: ]
7. Hide Item, this will hide the option from showing in the frontend, allowing to still keep the content in the menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180301905/original/a0RMIIQi1MJuEBki8PDflRX0KMGyuk0PhA.png?1781233338 | alt: ]
